comments.author: @MrCuriousEN
comments.text: What makes the Uros Islands so extraordinary is that the ground itself is something people have to maintain and rebuild. 🌾 At nearly 4,000 meters above sea level, daily life already means dealing with thin air and cold temperatures, yet these communities also depend on totora reeds for homes, boats and even the islands beneath them. It’s an incredible example of an entire culture adapting to one very specific environment.
